lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits, displaying a semi-regular spatial distribution along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that cross the horizontal rows of spots, creating a geometric lattice of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature running across the upper flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A non-uniform distribution of high-luminance blobs contained within the perimeter of the dorsal fin, with a higher concentration of spots visible along the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance shapes attached to the ventral and lower lateral surfaces, identified as commensal organisms.
